_comment: Single sign-on in the system browser (app-sso-system-browser), around the rules of system.json: where the start route opens, what the app does when the browser comes back, and where the redeem script leads. Read by Android's SystemSignInTest (SystemSignIn.opensBrowser, finish, ends) and the iOS app's SystemSignInTests (SystemSignIn.opensSheet, finish). `begin`: the server's health answer (`status` null: none) and whether a browser can take the sign-in (iOS always has its sheet, so it reads the cases with `browser` true). `finish`: the address the browser came back with (`url` null: the iOS sheet closed without one), whether a page of the server shows, and the step on each app: `redeem:<code>` runs the redeem script there, `redeemAfterLoad:<code>` loads the server first (Android), `error:<code>` shows the sign-in screen with that code, `stay` changes nothing; `ends`: whether Android's pending sign-in is over (only an answer with its state ends it). `redeem`: the server's answer to the redeem request (`throws`: no answer at all) and the address the script then replaces the page with; `script` is the script both apps give for `code` and `verifier`, which the iOS tests run against each answer. Error answers are the server's own (writeError): an expired, used or foreign code is oidc_state_invalid.

begin.case: a proxy answers for the server
an error status, whatever the body

finish.case: a code, on the server's page
a code, while another page shows
a code for another sign-in (state mismatch)
the sheet closed without an answer (iOS)
sign-ups closed, while another page shows

answers.case: signed in: the server's redirect is followed
an expired or already used code
a page that is not JSON
